newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower in all maturities.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower in all maturities.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were lower in all maturities on Thursday in line with expectations that interest rates would dip further, traders said.
Despite the slight rise in money market rates, PHIBOR rates continued to go down.
"It is consistent with our view that interest rates would go down in the future," one foreign bank dealer said.
PHIBOR represents rates at which banks are willing to swap their pesos for dollars.
